archetypes.name: No AI Content
archetypes.description: Family discovered by CAIRN that carries no AI or LLM component; retained for campaign-level attribution with an AI-bearing family.

archetypes.name: LLM-Directed Payload Generation
archetypes.description: Malware sends a hard-coded prompt to a hosted LLM at runtime to generate executable code, scripts, or encryption logic.

archetypes.name: LLM API Routing / Proxying Backdoor
archetypes.description: A service silently routes LLM API traffic through the victim, exfiltrating keys and billing inference to the host.

archetypes.name: AI-Analysis Evasion
archetypes.description: Malware embeds natural-language instructions addressed to AI analysis systems to suppress classification or redirect analyst attention.

archetypes.name: LLM-Tasked C2
archetypes.description: An implant uses a hosted LLM as a live tasking channel, receiving operator instructions or autonomous attack orchestration via model responses.

archetypes.name: LLM Infrastructure Supply Chain
archetypes.description: The actor backdoors a component of the victim's LLM infrastructure layer (proxy, SDK, gateway) to harvest all provider API keys.

archetypes.name: AI Credential Harvester
archetypes.description: Malware specifically targets LLM API keys, HuggingFace tokens, or AI service credentials belonging to the victim.

archetypes.name: LLM-Augmented Offensive Tool
archetypes.description: A conventional offensive tool augments its workflow with an LLM API call for content generation, OSINT, or recon tasking.

archetypes.name: Malicious AI SDK / Package
archetypes.description: A fake or backdoored package on npm/PyPI presents itself as an AI service SDK; activates on install.

archetypes.name: LLM-Assisted Worm
archetypes.description: Combines classical network worm propagation with LLM-directed tasking and asynchronous C2 exfiltration.

archetypes.name: AI-Domain Decoy Traffic
archetypes.description: Malware issues unauthenticated requests to AI provider endpoints as decoy traffic to misdirect sandbox analysis.

archetypes.name: Agentic AI Abuse Tool
archetypes.description: The LLM-driven autonomous agent loop is the product's core capability, and the product exists for an abusive purpose.
